[residual] If host later wraps curate as a service, the write path has no caller auth of its own.
[residual] Unguarded write into shared KG; if palimpsest ever runs multi-tenant this is unauthorized-by-default.
[residual] Multi-user deployment would need an owner/scope on who may materialize inferred summaries.
[residual] The provenance-key same-id divergent-content overwrite is real but is a data-integrity/idempotency issue, tracked there.
[residual] code-derived facts are sent to a 3rd-party model (confidentiality), but not regulatory; carried under pii-leak/secret.
[residual] Partial rollout across loader versions or missing optional-dep fails loudly at first generation, not silently.
[residual] created_at stored without format/range validation could mislead downstream freshness ordering.
[close_reason] No principal/identity auth introduced; only env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (SDK-internal) + host-injected driver. No auth mechanism implemented.
[close_reason] No access-control layer exists or is added; inferred layer is designed write-open + honestly-labeled. What guards the write is grounding + provenance honesty, not authz.
[close_reason] Single-user local opt-in CLI; no permission model stated or required by intent/ADR.
[close_reason] Single-shot CLI, one sequential session, no threads/locks. summary_id_unique constraint neutralizes the MERGE race. The provenance-key filename overwrite is single-threaded (belongs to data-integrity, not concurrency).
[close_reason] Java code-structure metadata domain; no PII/regulated data; no compliance obligation stated.
[close_reason] Opt-in subcommand NOT in default pipeline; curate/anthropic optional-dep, lazy import; new gap key already ignored by loader (ir.py:540).
[close_reason] created_at is opaque caller ISO-8601 passthrough, not an input to summary_id; code_bound_at from existing committed_at. No new time math.
